question: Which of the following developed a small electric vehicle in 2021 that can change its width on the go?
solution:
The correct answer is __**City Transformer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **City Transformer** is an Israeli startup that developed a revolutionary small electric vehicle (EV) in 2021.
 
• This EV features a unique ability to **adjust its width on the go**, making it highly adaptable for urban environments.
 
• The vehicle's width can shrink from **1.4 meters to 1 meter** to navigate through congested streets and fit into tight parking spaces.
 
• It is classified as a quadricycle and offers a top speed of **90 km/h**, making it suitable for city commutes.
 
• The vehicle is powered by electric motors and offers a range of up to **180 km** on a single charge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quadricycle Classification:**

 
 
• A quadricycle is a small vehicle that is lighter and less powerful than standard cars, often used for urban mobility.
 
• In the EU, quadricycles are divided into categories like L6e (light quadricycles) and L7e (heavy quadricycles).
 
 
 
• **Urban Mobility Challenges:**
 
 
• Increasing traffic congestion and limited parking spaces are major challenges in modern cities.
 
• Innovative vehicles like City Transformer address these issues by offering compact and flexible designs.
 
 
 
• **Electric Vehicle Advantages:**
 
 
• EVs contribute to reducing greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution.
 
• They are more energy-efficient compared to internal combustion engine vehicles.
 
 
 
• **City Transformer's Vision:**
 
 
• The company aims to revolutionize urban transportation by providing sustainable and space-efficient mobility solutions.
 
• Its foldable width design is a key innovation for addressing urban infrastructure constraints.
